name: foliole
description: Desktop knowledge workspace for local reading and review.
author: Foliole

scripts.build: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- npm run build:raw
scripts.build:raw: npm run appearance:colors:generate && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.lint:desktop: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- bash scripts/lint-changed.sh --scope desktop
scripts.lint:desktop:full: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --cache --cache-location .tmp/eslint-cache/desktop/ src/app src/features src/shared/ui src/shared/platform electron scripts/windows vite.config.ts playwright.desktop.config.ts
scripts.lint:android: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- bash scripts/lint-changed.sh --scope android
scripts.lint:android:full: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --cache --cache-location .tmp/eslint-cache/android/ src/companion src/shared/platform src/shared/ui src/shared/lib src/shared/commands src/shared/config capacitor.config.ts vite.companion.config.ts
scripts.lint:shared: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- bash scripts/lint-changed.sh --scope shared
scripts.lint:shared:full: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --cache --cache-location .tmp/eslint-cache/shared/ src/shared src/features src/store scripts/check-layer-dependency-boundary.mjs scripts/check-layer-dependency-boundary.test.mjs scripts/check-layer-dependency-boundary.runtime-exports.test.mjs scripts/check-layer-dependency-boundary.topology.test.mjs scripts/check-layer-dependency-boundary.workspace-layout.test.mjs scripts/layer-topology-inspector.mjs scripts/layer-topology-rules.mjs scripts/check-native-command-contracts.mjs scripts/check-native-command-contracts.test.mjs scripts/check-settings-classification.mjs scripts/check-settings-classification.test.mjs scripts/check-reading-typography-tokens.mjs scripts/lint-changed.test.mjs scripts/quality-gate-log.sh scripts/quality-gate-failure-summary.sh scripts/quality-gate-process.sh scripts/quality-gate-target.test.mjs scripts/quality-gate-target-collect.test.mjs scripts/quality-gate-fast.test.mjs scripts/quality-gate-skip-lint-integration.test.mjs scripts/quality-skip-lint.mjs scripts/quality-skip-lint.test.mjs scripts/run-vitest-with-summary.mjs scripts/run-vitest-with-summary.test.mjs scripts/vite-config.test.mjs vite.config.ts vite.companion.config.ts playwright.desktop.config.ts capacitor.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:shared: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- npm run typecheck:shared:raw
scripts.typecheck:desktop: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- npm run typecheck:desktop:raw
scripts.typecheck:android: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- npm run typecheck:android:raw
scripts.test:desktop: node scripts/run-vitest-with-summary.mjs .tmp/vitest/desktop.json -- --silent=passed-only --pool=threads --maxWorkers=2 --no-file-parallelism src/app src/features src/shared/platform src/shared/ui src/test src/startupBootstrap.test.ts src/startupViewMode.test.ts electron scripts/windows
scripts.test:android: node scripts/run-vitest-with-summary.mjs .tmp/vitest/android.json -- --silent=passed-only --pool=threads --maxWorkers=2 --no-file-parallelism src/companion src/shared/platform src/shared/ui src/shared/lib src/shared/commands scripts/android
scripts.test:shared: node scripts/run-vitest-with-summary.mjs .tmp/vitest/shared.json -- --silent=passed-only --pool=threads --maxWorkers=2 --no-file-parallelism src/shared src/features src/store scripts/check-settings-classification.test.mjs scripts/lint-changed.test.mjs scripts/vite-config.test.mjs
scripts.test:sync-pack: node scripts/electron-sqlite-runner.mjs scripts/run-vitest-with-summary.mjs .tmp/vitest/sync-pack.json -- --silent=passed-only --pool=threads --maxWorkers=2 --no-file-parallelism lib/core/sync/syncPackManifest.test.ts electron/database/syncPackManifest.test.ts electron/database/syncPackBuilder.test.ts electron/database/syncPackBuilder.genericObjects.test.ts electron/database/syncPackBuilder.contract.test.ts electron/database/syncPackRows.test.ts electron/database/syncPackExternalDocumentTombstoneScenario.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackApplyStatements.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackNodeApplyExecutor.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackStateRowsExecutor.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackSyncObjectsExecutor.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackContentBlobsExecutor.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackExternalDocumentsExecutor.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackAttachmentObjectsExecutor.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackReviewLogExecutor.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackViewStateObjectsExecutor.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackLearningObjectsExecutor.test.ts electron/sync/syncPackPushAcksExecutor.test.ts src/shared/platform/companionSyncPackApply.test.ts
scripts.check:android-boundary: node scripts/electron-sqlite-runner.mjs scripts/run-vitest-with-summary.mjs .tmp/vitest/android-boundary.json -- --silent=passed-only --pool=threads --maxWorkers=2 --no-file-parallelism scripts/android/java-adapter-boundary.test.mjs scripts/android/java-sql-surface.test.mjs scripts/android/schema-inventory.test.mjs scripts/android/android-sync-*.test.mjs src/shared/platform/companionSqlBoundary.test.ts src/shared/platform/companionSyncWriterQueue.test.ts
scripts.windows:preview: node scripts/preview-dedupe.mjs windows -- node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs preview -- bash scripts/windows/windows-preview.sh
scripts.windows:preview:native: node scripts/preview-dedupe.mjs windows -- node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs preview -- node scripts/windows/windows-preview-native.mjs
scripts.electron:compile: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- npm run electron:compile:raw
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --config electron/builder.json
scripts.android:web:build: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs node-heavy -- npm run android:web:build:raw
scripts.android:web:build:raw: npm run android:schema:generate && vite build --config vite.companion.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:desktop: node scripts/with-resource-gate.mjs preview -- node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --config playwright.desktop.config.ts
scripts.check:ios-boundary: npm run sync:sql-surface:scan && npm run ios:sqlite-capability:gate
